attacks.claim: The backfill estimate of about 9.7 h leaves almost no slack in two 5-hour nightly windows (10 h total). A slow night means a third night, though the job is idempotent and safe to restart.
Licence coverage for AP and Reuters derivatives rests on a photo desk confirmation, not on a reading of the contract terms. Low risk, since the images are only resized for the same display use.
